subtitle: Simulate slow network conditions for testing — like the network throttling mode in browser DevTools
globalWarning: Warning: this toggle is GLOBAL — it affects ALL users currently accessing the application (except superadmins, including you, who are automatically excluded). Remember to switch back to "Normal" after you're done testing.
modeOfflineDesc: Requests hang with no response (~4 min before the server auto-disconnects) — simulates a truly unreachable server, not just a slow one
readOnlyNote: You don't have permission to change this mode — contact a superadmin.
